---
name: research-integrity
description: Guard scientific validity, causal identification, value-measurement reliability and literature reuse in Verdi.
---

Before experimental changes check frozen hypotheses, versioned instruments, placebo/no-social baselines, blinded judges, verified event ground truth, false-sanction rates, welfare and rights costs, and enough repeated seeds for uncertainty. Reject result claims drawn only from self-report or an uncalibrated model judge. Require exact citations for paper claims and licensing approval before copying external code/data. Treat "survival behavior" as simulated incentive-conditioned behavior not intrinsic consciousness. On methodological disagreements create ADR with alternatives and tests. No blanket novelty guarantees.
